expected.raw_text: Interesse an Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Vektordatenbanken und Embedding-Techniken
Vertrautheit mit Model Context Protocol (MCP) oder Bereitschaft, sich intensiv einzuarbeiten
Du verstehst sowohl die klassische Backend-Welt als auch KI-Konzepte

parsed.notes:
The Backend section is required; the KI & ML and Bonus sections are optional. Persönliche Eigenschaften is a new, unmarked section and defaults to required.
Literally, the unmarked request to understand KI-Konzepte asks for broad AI knowledge, despite optional AI experience elsewhere; flagged for review.
Java/Kotlin and Kubernetes/OpenShift are read as alternatives; Python is separately required.
The cloud providers, CI/CD tools and named framework examples are treated as alternatives for their respective asks. Broad skills remain outside those groups.
Spring/Jakarta, Docker/Podman and ArgoCD/Flux include unmapped alternatives; no singleton mapped groups are emitted.
GitHub maps to git using the supplied alias, not to GitHub Actions. GitLab is interpreted as GitLab CI from its explicit CI/CD-tools context and flagged for review.
Pinecone, Qdrant and ChromaDB map to the same vector-databases ID and therefore collapse with the explicitly named broad skill; Weaviate has its own ID.
Experience in agile software-development teams is recorded as an unmapped technical practice, without inferring a separate general software-engineering requirement.
Responsibility-only technologies and practices are excluded. Fundierte and umfassende Erfahrung do not establish seniority under the guide.
